_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Vayikra 20, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses, speaking to him.
translations.2: Command the sons of Israel and say to them: Any person from the sons of Israel, or from the stranger who has entered among them, who gives of his offspring to the idols — let him be killed outright; that is, that the people of the town shall stone him with stones.
translations.3: And I shall pour out My wrath upon that person, and cut him off from among his people — since he gave of his offspring to the idols, in order to defile My sanctuary and to debase My holy name.
translations.4: And if the people of the town should turn a blind eye, looking away from that man even as he gives of his offspring to the idols, and they do not kill him —
translations.5: I shall pour out My wrath upon that person and upon those who are associated with him, and cut him off, and all those who rebelliously follow after him after the idol, from among their people.
translations.6: And any person who has turned to sorcerers and diviners, to lead the people astray in following them — I shall pour out My wrath upon that person, and cut him off from among his people.
translations.7: So sanctify yourselves and be holy, for I am God your Lord, the Holy One.
translations.8: And keep My statutes and act according to them, for I am God who sanctifies you.
translations.9: Any person who has cursed his father and his mother — let him be killed outright; since he cursed his father and his mother, his blood is thereby made forfeit.
translations.10: And any man who committed adultery with a man's wife, or committed adultery with the wife of his fellow — let the adulterer and the adulteress be killed outright.
translations.11: And any man who lay with his father's wife has thereby uncovered his father's nakedness — let them both be killed, for their blood is made forfeit by this.
translations.12: And any man who lay with his daughter-in-law — let them both be killed; since they did an outrageous thing, their blood is thereby made forfeit.
translations.13: And any man who lay with a male in the manner of lying with women — they have both together done an abomination; let them be killed outright, for their blood is made forfeit.
translations.14: And any man who took a woman and her mother — that is a vile act; let him and them both be burned with fire, on account of the degradation; and there shall be no vile act among you.
translations.15: And any man who directed his lying with a beast — let him be killed outright; and the beast also — kill it.
translations.16: And any woman who approached a beast to be mounted by it — kill the woman and the beast; since they did an outrageous thing, their blood is thereby made forfeit.
translations.17: And any man who took his sister — whether the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother — and looked upon her nakedness, and she looked upon his nakedness: that is a disgrace; they shall both be cut off from the presence of their people, since he uncovered the nakedness of his sister; he has borne his guilt.
translations.18: And any man who lay with a menstruating woman, uncovering her nakedness and laying bare her spring, and she too uncovered the spring of her blood — they shall both be cut off from among their people.
translations.19: The nakedness of your maternal aunt and your paternal aunt you shall not uncover; for whoever bares his kinswoman has thereby borne his guilt.
translations.20: And any man who lay with the wife of his paternal uncle has thereby uncovered his uncle's nakedness; and because they bore their guilt, they shall die childless.
translations.21: And any man who took the wife of his brother — she who has been separated from him — since he uncovered his brother's nakedness, they shall both be childless.
translations.22: And keep all My statutes and My ordinances, and act according to them; and do not let the land scatter you — the land into which I am bringing you there to possess it.
translations.23: And do not walk in the statutes of the nations whom I am driving out before you; for since they did all these things, I have come to loathe them.
translations.24: And I said to you, decreeing: You shall possess their land, and I shall give it to you to possess — a land flowing with milk and honey — for I am God your Lord, who has separated you from all the nations.
translations.25: So distinguish between the clean beast and the unclean, and between the unclean bird and the clean; and do not make yourselves loathsome with beasts and birds, and the rest of what creeps upon the earth — which I have set apart for you as unclean.
translations.26: And be holy unto Me, for I am God the Holy One; I have separated you from the nations that you may be Mine as a special possession.
translations.27: And any man or woman in whom there is a sorcerer or a diviner — let them both be killed outright; they shall be stoned with stones — their blood is thereby made forfeit.
